products.name: SS6 LED Fog Light Kit
productNotes: Maker note: "This kit is not compatible with the Trail Hunter trim or models equipped with Rigid Dual Color Fog Lights." This exclusion applies to any truck with those fog lights, whatever the trim.
Maker forum post: "This kit is for trucks equipped with fog lights from the factory."

SR.claim: The maker says the kit is for trucks with factory fog lights and that the SR has none from the factory.
SR.condition: Requires factory fog lamps. A factory SR does not meet this: Diode says "The SR does not come equipped from the factory with fog lamps" and that fog lamps on an SR would be an add-on kit it does not offer "at this time".

evidence.location: Opening post by the maker's account, 27 Jan 2026
evidence.quote: This kit is for trucks equipped with fog lights from the factory.

evidence.location: Maker reply, 29 Jan 2026, to an owner's warning that SR versions "may not fit without extensive bumper trim removal/cutting"
evidence.quote: The SR does not come equipped from the factory with fog lamps. That would be an add-on kit that we do not advertise or offer at this time.

evidence.location: Maker reply, 2 Feb 2026, to an owner willing to cut the bumper if a kit with a harness existed
evidence.quote: There is no add-on kit from our team as a heads-up.

retailerConflicts.claim: Fitment table lists SR among 2024-2026 Tacoma submodels.

SR.review: Diode has not said outright whether the SS6 is compatible with the SR, or whether an SR with fog lamps added later meets the requirement. Its product-page fitment note excludes the Trailhunter and Rigid dual-colour fogs but does not mention the SR. Until Diode answers either point, this stays Condition-dependent, not 'not compatible'.

TRD Off-Road.claim: The maker answered a wiring question from a 2025 TRD Off-Road owner but did not state trim fitment.

evidence.quote: This kit will have a wiring harness that goes from the factory fog light plug directly to the light bar, which controls the main beam.

TRD Off-Road.caveat: Downgraded from 'confirmed' in the 15 Oct pilot. Re-reading the answer on 19 Oct showed it addresses wiring only.
TRD Off-Road.gap: Does the kit fit the TRD Off-Road's fog openings? Diode's only answer for this trim is about wiring.

TRD Pro.claim: For the 2025 TRD Pro, the maker says the lights cannot be fully installed because the bumper openings are slimmer.

evidence.location: Q&A answer to a question about the 2025 TRD Pro with single-colour Rigid fogs, about 5 months before 19 Oct 2026
evidence.quote: While the single-color Rigid fogs do use the same connections and mounting points, the physical bumper openings are slimmer and don't allow our lights to be fully installed

retailerConflicts.claim: Fitment table lists TRD Pro among 2024-2026 Tacoma submodels.

Trailhunter.claim: The maker states the kit is not compatible with the Trailhunter trim.

evidence.location: Fitment note on the product page
evidence.quote: This kit is not compatible with the Trail Hunter trim or models equipped with Rigid Dual Color Fog Lights.
Unfortunately at this time, there are no immediate plans to offer a solution for those trims

retailerConflicts.claim: Fitment table lists Trailhunter among 2024-2026 Tacoma submodels.

extraEntries.claim: Not confirmed for 2024 or 2026 TRD Pro models. The maker's answer about the slimmer bumper openings concerned a 2025 TRD Pro.

evidence.location: Q&A answer about the 2025 TRD Pro (shown for context)
evidence.quote: While the single-color Rigid fogs do use the same connections and mounting points, the physical bumper openings are slimmer and don't allow our lights to be fully installed

retailerConflicts.claim: Fitment table lists TRD Pro among 2024-2026 Tacoma submodels.

extraEntries.caveat: Split out in the 19 Oct 2026 audit: the evidence covers 2025 only.
extraEntries.gap: Are the 2024 and 2026 TRD Pro bumper openings the same as the 2025's? Diode answered only for 2025.

products.defaultGap: Diode hasn't named this trim either way. It does exclude the Trailhunter, trucks with Rigid dual-colour fogs, and (for 2025) the TRD Pro, whose bumper openings it says are slimmer.

products.name: Form Lighting Type T3 LED Fog Lights (pair)
productNotes: The browser title says 2024-2025; the page heading and fitment section say 2024-2026.
The light's own name, "Type T3 Tacoma/Tundra/4Runner/Sequoia", describes the light type. It is not shown here as a 4Runner fitment statement for this Tacoma kit.

SR.claim: The maker states these fog lights are not compatible with SR trim levels.

evidence.location: Fitment note on the product page
evidence.quote: NOTE: These fog lights are not compatible with SR trim levels.

SR5.claim: An owner asked about an SR5 without factory fog lamps. The maker's answer addressed the SR, not the SR5.

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, these fog lights are not compatible with SR trim levels at this time - sorry!

SR5.caveat: The reply says "SR trim levels" (plural) in answer to an SR5 question. It is not treated as covering the SR5.
SR5.gap: Does the kit fit an SR5, with or without factory fog lamps? Diode's reply to an SR5 owner named the SR only.

products.defaultGap: Diode excludes the SR on this page but hasn't named this trim either way.

products.name: Stage Series Backlit Ditch Light Kit
productNotes: The browser title says 2024-2025; the page heading and fitment section say 2024-2026.
"Sport" and "Pro" in the part names are pod power levels, not vehicle trims.
Maker Q&A (about 3 months before 19 Oct 2026): the brackets do not fit a 2023 Tacoma: "No, you will need the mounts for a 2023 Tacoma."

TRD Off-Road|i-FORCE MAX hybrid.claim: The maker answered a wiring question (wire length to the battery) for a TRD Off-Road hybrid. Fitment was not addressed.

evidence.quote: We would recommend utilizing our included wiring harness, as it will have plenty of length to get power from the positive terminal post, which will be within the engine bay (even though the battery is in the cab).

TRD Off-Road|i-FORCE MAX hybrid.caveat: Downgraded in the 19 Oct 2026 audit: the source addresses wiring, not fitment.
TRD Off-Road|i-FORCE MAX hybrid.gap: Does the kit fit the hybrid TRD Off-Road? Diode's answer was about wire length to the battery, not fit.

Trailhunter.claim: The maker states it has not tested the kit on a 2025 Trailhunter.

evidence.quote: We have not tested the kit on a '25 Trailhunter just yet. However, we have not had any reports of incompatibility with that trim level either.

Trailhunter.caveat: "No reports of incompatibility" is not a fitment confirmation.
Trailhunter.gap: Does the kit fit the Trailhunter? Diode said it had not tested a 2025 Trailhunter and has said nothing about 2024 or 2026.

extraEntries.claim: Diode's own 4Runner page lists this kit (same part numbers) for the 2025-2026 4Runner. The fitment is vehicle-level: no 4Runner trim is named.

evidence.location: Fitment section of the 4Runner product page
evidence.quote: Fitment lists Make: Toyota, Model: 4Runner, Years: 2025, 2026; no trim is named.

evidence.location: Q&A on the Tacoma page, about 1 year 3 months before 19 Oct 2026 (question: "Does this work on the 2025 4Runner for trims that include AUX switches?")
evidence.quote: Absolutely! The included wiring harness will have some wiring that gives you the option to tie into factory upfitter switches for control.
Stage Series Ditch Light Bracket Kit for Toyota Tacoma/4Runner

extraEntries.caveat: Changed in the 19 Oct 2026 audit. It was 'Condition-dependent' on a Q&A answer; Diode's dedicated 4Runner page (found during the value audit) is the primary source. Vehicle-level fitment is not treated as trim-level confirmation, as for every Tacoma entry.
extraEntries.gap: Does the kit fit every 2025-2026 4Runner trim? Diode's 4Runner page names the vehicle and years only.

products.defaultGap: Diode lists the Tacoma 2024-2026 without naming any trim. Its only trim answers are "not tested" (2025 Trailhunter) and a wiring answer (TRD Off-Road hybrid).

products.name: TRD Pro Grille Light Bar Kit
products.defaultClaim: The maker's fitment section lists Toyota Tacoma 2024-2026 and names no trims. For grilles without a light-bar opening, see the condition on the other trims.
productNotes: Official inconsistency: the overview says the brackets "mount a 30-inch LED Light Bar", but the kit contents list "One (1) SS20 Standard LED Light Bar".
The maker states the kit was "confirmed for OEM grilles only" and it "cannot confirm fitment on an aftermarket grille".
On a TRD Pro, the maker says the included harness and a new switch must be used: "The factory switch cannot be used to control this light bar."

TRD Sport.claim: With the factory TRD Sport grille: not compatible. The grille lacks the mounting provisions and opening.
TRD Sport.condition: The maker separately says a TRD Pro grille from Toyota is needed if your grille has no light-bar opening.

evidence.quote: No, the TRD Sport grille does not have the mounting provisions or opening for the Lightbar
If you do not have this opening, you would need to purchase the TRD Pro grille from Toyota.

retailerConflicts.claim: Fitment table lists TRD Sport (and every other 2024-2026 submodel).

TRD Pro.claim: The maker states the kit includes everything needed to install it on a TRD Pro grille.
TRD Pro.condition: Use the included harness with the new switch; the factory switch cannot control this light bar.

evidence.quote: Yes, this kit will come with everything needed to install the kit onto your TRD Pro grill!

evidence.location: Fitment note on the product page
evidence.quote: The factory switch cannot be used to control this light bar.

Trailhunter.claim: The maker answered a 2026 Trailhunter wiring question (an OEM aux adapter is included) but did not state grille fitment.

evidence.quote: Yes, this kit will come with an OEM aux adapter, so you can unplug our switch and route this to the factory wiring.

Trailhunter.gap: Does the Trailhunter grille take this light bar? Diode answered a wiring question only.

needs-pro-grille.claim: Not confirmed for this trim. The maker's grille requirement (an OEM grille with a light-bar opening, like the TRD Pro grille) was stated in answers about a 2025 TRD Sport and an aftermarket grille; this trim is not named.

evidence.quote: You would need to have the style grille like in the listing photos with an opening for a light bar.
If you do not have this opening, you would need to purchase the TRD Pro grille from Toyota.
This was confirmed for OEM grilles only, so we cannot confirm fitment on an aftermarket grille - sorry!

needs-pro-grille.caveat: Downgraded in the 19 Oct 2026 audit (related-trim generalisation). Maker requirement, for reference: a grille with a light-bar opening; aftermarket grilles not confirmed.
needs-pro-grille.gap: Does this trim's factory grille have the light-bar mounting provisions and opening the kit needs? Diode says the TRD Sport grille does not; it hasn't said for this trim.
